text_block_list.text:
After school, as I was about to head home 
after finishing work, I heard singing from 
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, strike a pose stage 
right♪ Four, five, six, strike a pose 
stage left♪

Following the voice, I found the lights on 
in the dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right, not done yet! One more time. 
Let's practice~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Oguri-senpai! Are you here for 
practice too~?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No, I came to lock up the room, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! No way, it's already that late?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, but there are still steps I want to 
check...! The actual performance is coming 
up soon, too...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, please~!! Could you wait just a 
little bit longer?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Understood. I shall wait a little 
while.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And here we go... a perfect turn♪ Yep, 
looking good☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
How was that, Oguri-senpai! What do you 
think of Umadol Falco's performance!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... This song, somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait, you weren't listening at all~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Right... I know this song. I danced to it 
once back in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Ah, that's right! You came from the 
regional circuit, Oguri-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm running in a regional race soon, so I 
was practicing for that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The academy teaches us the central tracks' 
songs, but you have to practice the 
regional ones all on your own!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see. Still... you are remarkably 
devoted.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Back when I ran in the regional races, 
there were few girls who put so much 
thought into their Winning Live 
performances.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So I've heard. But—I'm an Umadol!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For the fans waiting for me, and for 
everyone who's gonna become my fan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere, with a sparkling smile! 
I want to give them the absolute best 
performance☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Impressive... Perhaps I, too, should learn 
from your spirit.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Really~?! Well then, well then, why don't 
you aim to become one too, Oguri-senpai?! 
Everyone's U-ma-dol♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Umadol aside, this gave me a good chance 
to reflect on how one ought to carry 
oneself on stage.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However... setting that aside, I really 
must lock up soon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Umm, could we maybe let this room shine 
just a liiittle bit longer...?☆

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That would be troublesome. If I don't lock 
up, the teacher will scold me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please, just work with me here! The race 
is coming right up~! Just a little bit 
more, pretty pleaseee~!
